content.title: About
content.content: Khorasan is an ancient wheat variety known for its large, slightly nutty flavor and dense texture. Puffed flakes made from organic Khorasan are produced by a heat‑expansion process that retains most nutrients while giving a light, crunchy bite. The product is suitable for breakfasts, baking, and snacks.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Khorasan is often called “the first wheat” and has been cultivated for over 8,000 years.
Organic Khorasan is grown without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers, making it more environmentally friendly.
Puffed Khorasan flakes retain more protein and fiber than typical wheat flakes.
The large grains contain higher levels of magnesium and zinc compared with common wheat.
Although Khorasan contains gluten, it has less than regular wheat, which is why it is sometimes used in reduced‑gluten diets.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Khorasan provides about 15 % protein, supporting muscle maintenance and satiety.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Dietary fiber aids healthy digestion and helps regulate blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of minerals
items.content: It supplies magnesium, zinc, and selenium, essential for metabolism and immune function.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Organic cultivation preserves phytochemicals that combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: The blend of healthy fats, fiber, and minerals contributes to healthy cholesterol levels.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: People allergic to wheat or gluten may react to this product.

items.title: Gluten content
items.content: Although lower than regular wheat, gluten is still present and not suitable for a strict gluten‑free diet.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The flakes can be calorie‑dense, so portion control is recommended.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the flakes dry as a light snack, add them to milk, yogurt or plant‑based milk, incorporate into baked goods (granola bars, muffins), or use as a crunchy topping for salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from light. For longer shelf life, keep refrigerated to maintain crunch and prevent fat oxidation.
